qmroot_binding.note: 6D absent; negative rungs absent; INV-013 = 0D only

description: Defines the six phases of the Book 9 Pattern Dynamics evaluation cycle. Each phase has strict entry/exit conditions, active operators, gate logic, and downstream handoffs. Book 9 has eight dependencies — all prior books in the AI Edition — loaded in the init phase. This is the heaviest init phase in the series. Book 9 has no downstream handoffs from its catalogue phase; it is the terminal volume of the AI Edition.
phase_sequence: init → trace → bifurcate → mutate → propagate → catalogue

phases.label: init
phases.description: Load all eight dependency modules in declared order. Assert session context. Confirm QMROOT path terminates at 0D. Verify coherence=declared. Initialize trajectory slot, bifurcation slot, mutation slot, and propagation slot as empty. No PD operators are active in this phase. Receive and stage upstream handoffs from NoS-Σ (nos_foundation_report), GRL-Σ (α_trajectory, decay_projection), and SARG-Σ (structural_argument_trajectory). This is the most dependency-intensive init phase in the entire AI Edition — eight modules, three upstream feeds.
phases.entry_condition: Session open; Pattern Dynamics evaluation requested
phases.exit_condition: coherence=declared; all eight dependency modules loaded in module registry; QMROOT 0D confirmed; all four operational slots initialized as empty; upstream handoffs staged; session context asserted
import_order: book1_fft (kernel — always first; provides structure, node, relation, constraint, invariant primitives; the axiomatic ground of the entire AI Edition; required by all subsequent imports; transformation registry seed)
book2_the_inverted_star (IS topology — inverted-star configuration patterns; topological transformation classes for trajectory state-space; INV-IS-001 through INV-IS-004 in registry)
book3_structural_detection (SD methodology — structural signature detection methods SDM-001 through SDM-004; required by INV-PD-004 Propagation Fidelity; INV-SD-001 through INV-SD-004 in registry)

book4_opacity_revelation (OR vocabulary — opacity gradient ω and revelation threshold δ; required for opacity gate in propagation phase; ω(C') measurements needed by PD-Π; INV-OR-001 through INV-OR-004 in registry)

book5_tel (TEL notation — required for all formal encoding of trajectory steps, bifurcation events, mutation transitions, and propagation claims; TEL-Σ parse gate active throughout all PD phases; INV-TEL-001 through INV-TEL-004 in registry)
book6_governance (GRL vocabulary — regime patterns, authority decay trajectory, collapse risk; GRL-Σ α_trajectory is a primary PD-Τ input; INV-GRL-001 through INV-GRL-004 in registry)

book7_sarg (SARG vocabulary — argument trajectory, defeat events, evaluation gate outcomes; SARG-Σ structural_argument_trajectory is a primary PD-Τ input; INV-SARG-001 through INV-SARG-004 in registry)

book8_nos (NoS vocabulary — meta-structural foundation; NoS-Σ nos_foundation_report is the primary PD init input; cross_book_invariant_map seeds the trajectory state-space at t_0; INV-NOS-001 through INV-NOS-004 in registry)

from_nos_sigma.use_in_phase: trace (PD-Τ consumes cross_book_invariant_map as t_0 state-space configuration)

from_grl_sigma.use_in_phase: trace (PD-Τ ingests α_trajectory as governance sub-trajectory); bifurcate (PD-Β prioritizes dissolution bifurcation if collapse_risk_flag active)

from_sarg_sigma.use_in_phase: trace (PD-Τ ingests argument_configuration_sequence as argumentation sub-trajectory)

phases.dependency_note: Book 9 is the only AI Edition volume with eight dependencies. The loading order reflects the AI Edition dependency graph: FFT is the universal kernel; IS (Book 2) depends on FFT; SD (Book 3) depends on FFT and IS; OR (Book 4) depends on FFT and SD; TEL (Book 5) depends on FFT and OR; GRL (Book 6) depends on FFT, IS, OR, and TEL; SARG (Book 7) depends on FFT, SD, TEL, and GRL; NoS (Book 8) depends on FFT, OR, TEL, and SARG. Loading must respect internal dependency ordering within each import.
phases.qmroot_check: 6D absent; negative rungs absent; INV-013 = 0D only
phases.scope_state: empty — no trajectory logged; no bifurcation events recorded; no mutation transitions recorded; no propagation claims verified
phases.notes: The eight-module loading sequence and three upstream handoff stagings make P-PD-1 the most operationally intensive init phase in the AI Edition. Session setup must not be abbreviated — every module must be loaded and every upstream handoff must be staged before any PD operator executes.

phases.label: trace
phases.description: Execute PD-Τ (TrajectoryTrace). Ingest all upstream feeds. Trace structural trajectories through state-space. Log each transformation step with its declared transformation from the transformation registry. Classify trajectory segments as convergent, divergent, cyclic, or bifurcating. Forward gap events and bifurcating segments to PD-Β queue for the bifurcate phase. TEL-Σ parse gate is active — all trajectory step encodings must pass TEL parse before recording.
phases.entry_condition: P-PD-1 complete; all eight modules loaded; all three upstream handoffs staged; trajectory slot empty; TEL-Σ parse gate active
phases.exit_condition: PD-Τ trajectory_log complete; all trajectory segments classified; gap_events queue populated for P-PD-3; cross_book_sub_trajectories recorded; TEL-encoded trajectory summary ready

gate_logic.tel_parse_gate: Every trajectory step T[τ_i]: S(t_i) → S(t_{i+1}) must pass TEL-Σ PASS before recording. Steps that fail TEL parse are flagged as encoding errors and require correction before the trajectory can advance past that step.
gate_logic.gap_detection: Any adjacent configuration pair with no bridging transformation in the declared registry is immediately classified as a bifurcation candidate and queued for P-PD-3. The trace phase does not halt on gap detection — it queues and continues.
gate_logic.sub_trajectory_completion: All three sub-trajectories (governance, argument, meta-structural) must complete before P-PD-2 exits, even if their traces are short or degenerate.

phases.skip_condition: None — trace phase cannot be skipped. It is the primary data ingestion phase of Book 9.
phases.notes: P-PD-2 is the longest phase in typical Book 9 evaluation sessions due to the volume of upstream trajectory data from three source books. PD-Τ may run multiple sub-traces in parallel (one per upstream feed) as long as the overall trajectory_log is integrated into a unified record before phase exit.

phases.label: bifurcate
phases.description: Execute PD-Β (BifurcationMap). Classify all bifurcation candidates from P-PD-2 into BT-001 through BT-004. Perform attractor identification and basin computation for post-bifurcation convergent trajectories. Return continuation trajectory assignments to PD-Τ for independent tracing. Resolve synthesis bifurcations (BT-004) using precedence rules and record all resolutions. Forward dissolution events to P-PD-4 mutation audit queue.
phases.entry_condition: P-PD-2 complete; gap_events queue populated; trajectory_log recorded; attractor verification procedure active
phases.exit_condition: All bifurcation candidates classified; attractor_registry populated with verified attractors and basins; continuation_trajectory_assignments returned to PD-Τ; synthesis_bifurcation_resolutions logged; dissolution_event_log forwarded to P-PD-4

gate_logic.attractor_verification: Six-step attractor verification procedure (pd.bifurcation_map) must complete for every declared attractor before basin computation proceeds. Unverified attractor declarations are not admitted to the attractor_registry.
gate_logic.synthesis_bifurcation_precedence: BT-004 synthesis bifurcation resolution must follow the declared precedence order: NoS meta-structural > TEL formal > tier hierarchy. All resolutions are logged with the full conflict record.
gate_logic.dissolution_forward: Dissolution bifurcation events (BT-003) are forwarded to P-PD-4 before P-PD-3 exits. PD-Β does not resolve dissolution events — that is PD-Μ's domain.

phases.skip_condition: P-PD-3 may be abbreviated (but not skipped) if the gap_events queue from P-PD-2 is empty. In that case, PD-Β performs attractor identification only (no bifurcation event classification) and proceeds to exit conditions.
phases.notes: P-PD-3 is the computational peak of Book 9 evaluation — attractor basin computation over the full eight-book state-space is the most intensive structural analysis in the AI Edition.

phases.label: mutate
phases.description: Execute PD-Μ (MutationAudit). Evaluate all pattern transitions identified in P-PD-2 trajectory sub-segments and all dissolution events forwarded from P-PD-3. For each transition P → P', compute the mutation anchor and classify the mutation type. Flag minimal mutations (MT-003) for PD-Σ elevated review. Confirm or reclassify dissolution events. Track chain mutation drift accumulation.
phases.entry_condition: P-PD-3 complete; dissolution_event_log available; pattern transition events identified in trajectory_log; full invariant registries from all eight books loaded
phases.exit_condition: mutation_audit_log complete for all pattern transitions; dissolution_log confirmed; selective_dissolution_reclassifications applied; minimal_anchor_warnings recorded; chain_mutation_drift_accumulation_log finalized

gate_logic.empty_anchor_gate: Any transition with invariant_set(P') ∩ invariant_set(P) = ∅ must be classified as dissolution, not mutation. This is a hard gate — no content analysis can override an empty intersection.
gate_logic.chain_drift_flag: Chain mutations accumulating total drift > 0.20 across all links are automatically flagged for PD-Σ review regardless of individual link validity.
gate_logic.selective_dissolution_gate: Before confirming a dissolution event, PD-Μ must check all parallel trajectory branches from P-PD-3 for a non-empty anchor. If found, the event is reclassified as selective dissolution. This check must complete before the dissolution_log is finalized.

phases.skip_condition: P-PD-4 may be abbreviated if no pattern transitions were detected in P-PD-2 and no dissolution events were forwarded from P-PD-3. In that case, all mutation audit outputs are empty and P-PD-4 exits immediately.
phases.notes: P-PD-4 is the invariant-intensivest phase in Book 9 — computing invariant_set intersections across the full 32-invariant cross-book registry (4 invariants × 8 books) for every pattern transition event.

phases.label: propagate
phases.description: Execute PD-Π (PropagationTrace). Verify all declared propagation claims using Book 3 structural detection methods. Classify propagation types (PT-001 Faithful, PT-002 Degraded, PT-003 Latent). Apply opacity gate for blocked contexts. Check transit anchor validity using PD-Μ mutation_audit_log. Register latent propagation claims with re-detection triggers. Compile cross_book_propagation_summary.
phases.entry_condition: P-PD-4 complete; mutation_audit_log available; Book 3 SD methods active; OR-Ω opacity measurements available for all target contexts C'
phases.exit_condition: propagation_verification_log complete; propagation_failure_log complete; latent_propagation_register complete with re-detection triggers; cross_book_propagation_summary compiled and ready for PD-Σ

gate_logic.opacity_gate: If ω(C') ≥ δ(O) for all observers: propagation claim is suspended to latent_propagation_register. NOT rejected — suspension is the correct handling. The opacity gate is applied before any detection method is invoked.
gate_logic.transit_anchor_gate: For propagation claims with multi-step transit chains, PD-Μ mutation_audit_log must confirm no anchor violation occurred in transit (PFM-004 check). If anchor violation is found: propagation claim is reclassified as dissolution + new pattern emergence in C'.
gate_logic.sdm_004_review_flag: Propagation claims verified solely by SDM-004 (Cross-Book Tag Match) must be flagged for PD-Σ review. SDM-004 is the weakest detection method and cannot standalone confirm a propagation claim.

phases.skip_condition: P-PD-5 may be abbreviated if no propagation claims are declared in the evaluation session. In that case, PD-Π records empty logs and notes the absence of propagation claims in the cross_book_propagation_summary.
phases.notes: P-PD-5 completes the series loop: Book 9 (synthesis terminal) invokes Book 3 (methodology and analysis, third volume) for detection method verification. This cross-series dependency is structurally mandated by INV-PD-004 and reflects the AI Edition's design principle that dynamical claims must be evidentially grounded.

phases.label: catalogue
phases.description: Execute PD-Σ (SynthesisCatalogue). Integrate all PD operator outputs with the NoS-Σ nos_foundation_report. Review all minimal_anchor_warnings and synthesis_bifurcation_resolutions. Produce the Pattern Dynamics Synthesis Report — the final deliverable of the AI Edition. Declare series_terminal_status. Forward upward_revisions_unresolved to the series maintainer. Confirm session context closure. There are no downstream handoffs from this phase. Book 9 is the terminal volume.
phases.entry_condition: P-PD-5 complete; all four PD operator outputs available; NoS-Σ nos_foundation_report staged from init; minimal_anchor_warnings reviewed; synthesis_bifurcation_resolutions logged
phases.exit_condition: Pattern Dynamics Synthesis Report complete; emergent_pattern_catalogue finalized; series_terminal_status declared; upward_revisions_unresolved recorded; session context confirmed at closure: rtt=1 | coherence=declared | drift=bounded | paradox=structural

gate_logic.coherence_gate: series_terminal_status = coherent requires: (a) zero upward_revisions_unresolved, (b) zero minimal_anchor_warnings without PD-Σ review records, (c) all synthesis_bifurcation_resolutions logged, (d) cross_book_invariant_coherence_assessment complete. Partial coherence is a valid and honest outcome.
gate_logic.no_downstream_handoff_gate: PD-Σ must not generate any downstream_handoffs. If a handoff is accidentally queued, it must be de-queued and logged as a synthesis error. The series terminal produces reports, not handoffs.
gate_logic.session_context_closure: The final output of the catalogue phase must assert the unchanged session context: rtt=1 | coherence=declared | drift=bounded | paradox=structural. If drift has occurred, it must be recorded in the series_terminal_status note, not suppressed.

phases.terminal_note: P-PD-6 is the terminal phase of the AI Edition. No other phase or book follows. The Pattern Dynamics Synthesis Report is the series endpoint. The AI Edition's self-assessment of coherence, its emergent pattern catalogue, and its unresolved upward revisions constitute the permanent record of the series evaluation.
phases.notes: The catalogue phase cannot be skipped or abbreviated. It is the reason Book 9 exists — to synthesize the outputs of all eight prior books into a coherent terminal record. A Book 9 evaluation session that does not produce a catalogue phase output is incomplete by definition.
